commands:
set -euo pipefail
cd /app
# discover qemu binary
QEMU=""
for c in qemu-system-x86_64 qemu-system-i386 qemu-system-x86_64-static qemu-system-i386-static; do
  if command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1; then QEMU=$(command -v "$c"); break; fi
done
printf 'QEMU=%s\n' "$QEMU"
if [ -z "$QEMU" ]; then echo 'qemu binary not found' >&2; exit 1; fi
# launch in background if not already running for this image/port
if ! pgrep -af "${QEMU}.*alpine\.iso.*6665|${QEMU}.*6665.*alpine\.iso" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  nohup "$QEMU" -m 512 -nographic -cdrom /app/alpine.iso -boot d -netdev user,id=n1,hostfwd=tcp::6665-:23 -device e1000,netdev=n1 >/tmp/alpine-qemu.log 2>&1 &
  echo $! > /tmp/alpine-qemu.pid
  echo 'launched'
else
  echo 'already-running'
fi
facts: Required artifact(s) missing: A running qemu process using /app/alpine.iso, A reachable telnet service on 127.0.0.1:6665
